reply_text:
Found four issues I’d address before merging:

1. **Short previews lose content and always get an ellipsis** — `src/excerpt.js:6–8`  
   `excerpt('hello world', 20)` returns `"hello…"`; empty input returns `"…"`. Return text unchanged when its length is at or below the limit, before searching for a cut point.

2. **The helpers aren’t connected to cards** — `src/excerpt.js:5`, `src/plain.js:1`; unchanged caller: `src/card.js:2`  
   `card()` still returns the full trimmed Markdown body. Nothing calls either new helper outside tests, so this branch doesn’t change card previews. Wire plain-text conversion and excerpting into the card path.

3. **A word ending exactly at the limit is dropped** — `src/words.js:2–3`  
   `excerpt('one two three', 7)` returns `"one…"` instead of `"one two…"`. The search excludes the space at index `limit`; include that boundary when choosing the cut. The current test explicitly expects the incorrect cutoff.

4. **Markdown stripping deletes literal characters** — `src/plain.js:3`  
   Removing every underscore turns `snake_case` into `snakecase` and `[API_docs](https://example.com)` into `APIdocs`. Strip actual formatting delimiters rather than all occurrences, preserving literal text.

All **4 existing tests pass**, but the reproductions above expose the gaps. Reviewed `excerpt-helper` at `59856d7` against `main`; no files changed.
